title: Review verdict (exeris-kernel)
description: The bundle's shape, narrowed to this repository's reviewing roles and scope vocabulary. The three-state `decision` and the `checks_run` contract — a check that did not run says so rather than being omitted — are the base's; only the vocabulary is local. `scope_class` is the shared pull-request template's own line, so a verdict and the PR body classify a change the same way.
